study_design: Randomized controlled trial with prostate cancer incidence analyzed as a secondary endpoint
reason: The abstract analyzes overall incident prostate cancer but does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incidence endpoint.
